title: The source-shift square on K-injective representatives
statement:
theorem derived_source_shift_model
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ)
    (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY) :
    ∀ (P I : K l E Y s) (hI : I.IsKInjective) (a : ℤ),
      c.derived.hom.app
          (op (((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)⟦a⟧),
            (podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I) ≫
        (podReindexingDerivedHom l E X s).map
            (Prod.mkHom
            (((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).commShiftIso a).inv.app
              ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)).op
            (𝟙 ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj
              ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I)))) ≫
        (CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.sourceShift.{u + 1, u, u, u + 2}
          (ProEt.topology X) (podReindexingRing l E X s)
          ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj
            ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)) a).inv.app
              ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj
                ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I)) =
      (podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).map
        ((CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.sourceShift.{u + 1, u, u, u + 2}
          (ProEt.topology Y) (podReindexingRing l E Y s)
          ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P) a).inv.app
            ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I)) ≫
        ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).commShiftIso (-a)).hom.app
          ((podReindexingDerivedHom l E Y s).obj
            (op ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P), (podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I)) ≫
        (c.derived.hom.app
          (op ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P), (podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I))⟦-a⟧'

source.place: Step 4, signed source shift of the representative internal Hom. Detailed normalization uses Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0A8X and 08JA, and the recorded LeftNormalization.

proof.text: Comparison.derived_model supplies K-injectivity of KI. The existing leftShift_existsUnique normalization supplies signed chain source-shift isomorphisms eY and eX with their LeftFormula laws on the two sites.

Precompose the desired square with sourceModelInput.hom and postcompose with sourceModelOutput.hom. The two normalization lemmas identify its left and right composites with localization of the respective chain composites, between the same outside factors.
source_chain_square identifies these chain composites. Rewriting under Q proves the equality with outside factors. Cancel the model isomorphisms to obtain the representative derived square.

proof_origin.note: Explicit specialization and factorization of the representative signed-source argument in the assigned node; the unit route is unchanged.
